title: fix(routing): enforce RoutingManager is the last widget
body:
fix #3148

See the issue for more context.

Those widgets can't be added back in IS.js:

* [toggle](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=unmount\&selectedStory=Toggle.default)
* [starRating](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=unmount\&selectedStory=StarRating.default)
* [menu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=unmount\&selectedStory=Menu.default)

But they can with this patch.

* [toggle](https://deploy-preview-3149--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=unmount\&selectedStory=Toggle.default)
* [starRating](https://deploy-preview-3149--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=unmount\&selectedStory=StarRating.default)
* [menu](https://deploy-preview-3149--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?widgets=unmount\&selectedStory=Menu.default)

The underlying reason is that the router needs to have a complete state before going through its own `getConfiguration` because it will iterate over all the widgets which expects to have their own `getConfiguration` called first.
